title: Black Clover to Launch New Release After Finale With Never Before Seen Content
content: Black Clover has revealed that it’s coming back with a brand new release that’s going to show off some new materials that never made it into the original manga run. Yuki Tabata officially brought Black Clover to an end after 11 years of serialization, and that meant that fans had to say goodbye to Asta and the Clover…
author: ComicBook

title: Grow Up Show: Sunflower Circus Anime Streams Video for Circus Collection Arc
content: The staff for Aniplex , A-1 Pictures , and Psyde Kick Studio 's original anime project Grow Up Show: Sunflower Circus - ( Grow Up Show: Himawari no Circus-dan ) revealed a new promotional video and key visual for the Circus Collection arc on Saturday. The Circus Collection arc began with the 10th episode on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Bleach’s Final Season Gets Surprise Delay With Hulu & Fans Aren’t Happy
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has been hit with a surprising snag with the release of its latest episode on Hulu, and fans of the anime certainly aren’t happy about it. Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity was the most anticipated new anime of the Summer , and it’s no surprise as to why as fans have been…

title: My Hero Academia Creator Returns With New Look at Mirko After Grand Finale
content: My Hero Academia ‘s creator has returned with a new look at the Rabbit Hero Mirko after the TV anime’s grand finale. My Hero Academia officially brought its ten year story to an end with its final TV anime releases this year, and fans are still saying their emotional goodbyes after everything that has gone down .
author: ComicBook

title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 47 Streaming Delayed as Schedule Moves to Tuesdays for Numerous Platforms in Japan
content: The streaming schedule for BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War will change beginning with Episode 47, resulting in the episode arriving on September 8 for numerous platforms. Until now, new episodes on the affected streaming services began rolling out every Sunday at 12:00 JST.
author: Anime Corner

title: 6 Years Later, Fan-Favorite Crunchyroll Isekai Finally Confirms Season 2 Release – Watch the Trailer
content: A major Isekai now streaming with Crunchyroll has finally confirmed it’s coming back with Season 2 in a new trailer showing off its return after six long years of waiting for it.
author: ComicBook

title: Boichi's The Marshal King Manga Resumes
content: Viz Media is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story: A two-fisted tale about desperadoes and the marshals who hunt them! High-octane adventure in the American Wild West as imagined by the genius illustrator Boichi , the artist of Dr. Stone and One Piece: Ace's Story !
author: ANN

title: Famed Akira, Naruto Animator Yuji Yanase Dies at 59
content: After at least four decades of contributions to the anime industry, Yuji Yanase has left the industry following a tragic incident. The acclaimed animator Yuji Yanase rose through the industry as you would expect of any animator, working hard at his craft and showcasing his passion.
author: ComicBook

title: New Detective Conan Anime Special Lets Fans Deduce Culprit
content: A livestreamed 30th anniversary special for the Detective Conan anime announced on Saturday that a new original Detective Conan anime special will air in Japan. For the first time in the franchise , this Misohitojima no Satsujin (The Misohitojima Murder Case) anime will have viewers attempt to deduce the culprit.
author: ANN

title: Netflix Has Raised UK Subscription Rates
content: Deadline has announced that Netflix raised its UK subscription rates on Friday September 3. The pricing applies to both new and existing customers. The Standard with Ads subscription has risen 33.4% from £5.99 to £7.99 a month.
author: ANN
